title: Windows Diagnostic Data & Telemetry Pipeline
description: Continuous capture of system diagnostics, typing behavior, and OS states dispatched to central telemetry endpoints.
impact: Exfiltration of usage patterns, device configurations, and behavioral parameters to external servers.

title: Windows 11 Recall & Background Screen Vectorization
description: Systemic background desktop snapshots, optical character recognition (OCR), and semantic vector profiling of user sessions.
impact: Unencrypted local indexing of credentials, financial portals, and sensitive documentation subject to exfiltration.

title: Windows Copilot Cloud Context & Semantic Stream
description: Active window contents, task patterns, and contextual OS prompts relayed to external cloud artificial intelligence models.
impact: Continuous leakage of real-time workspace metadata to remote processing infrastructures.

title: Keystroke Samples & Handwriting Telemetry Harvest
description: Customized input dictionaries, handwriting samples, and typing cadences synchronized with Microsoft cloud services.
impact: Keylogging exposure risk and harvesting of biometric stylus handwriting artifacts.

title: Tailored Experiences & Diagnostic Profile Matching
description: Operating system bridges telemetry metadata with user identities to serve targeted recommendations and contextual promotions.
impact: Systemic behavioral fingerprinting and non-consensual promotional injection.

title: Scheduled Telemetry Wake-up Tasks & CEIP Probes
description: Automated background tasks designed to re-awaken disabled telemetry services on strict calendar schedules.
impact: Recurring hardware audits and app inventories executed without active user consent.

title: Universal Advertising Identifier (Advertising ID)
description: Static advertising GUID assigned to the local account for cross-application behavioral tracking and target profiling.
impact: Persistent cross-software tracking and commercial profiling.

title: Start Menu Search Exfiltration & Bing Cloud Query Relay
description: Local file system and application search queries routed across internet pipes to remote search servers.
impact: Accidental exposure of confidential filenames, queries, and phrases over public networks.

title: Microsoft Edge Background Daemon & Diagnostic Probes
description: Persistent browser daemons active post-shutdown, dispatching browsing metrics and diagnostic memory telemetry.
impact: Unnecessary background memory consumption and persistent tracking of browsing activity.

title: P2P Update Seeding Relay (Delivery Optimization / WUDO)
description: Local disk and upstream internet bandwidth recruited to seed updates across LAN and internet peers.
impact: Unregulated network bandwidth consumption and external visibility of active machine presence.

title: Legacy Name Resolution Protocols (LLMNR & NetBIOS)
description: Multicast and broadcast protocol fallback broadcasting NetNTLM password challenge responses across local subnets.
impact: Susceptibility to local credential theft, relay attacks, and network eavesdropping.

title: Cleartext DNS Inquiries (Enforce DNS-over-HTTPS)
description: Plaintext domain lookup queries transmitted to ISP gateways without transport layer encryption.
impact: Local gateway eavesdropping and wholesale DNS browsing history profiling by network providers.

title: Wi-Fi Sense & Automatic Hotspot Reconnection
description: Automatic credential synchronization and autonomous connection to untrusted open wireless networks.
impact: Rogue hotspot interception and unauthorized broadcast of Wi-Fi profile parameters.

title: Connected User Experiences & Diagnostic Daemons (DiagTrack)
description: Primary low-level telemetry daemon collecting kernel crash dumps, device sensors, and software executions.
impact: Continuous background resource utilization and real-time telemetry streaming.

title: Windows Error Reporting & Crash Dump Exfiltration
description: Application crashes trigger full memory stack dumps submitted to remote servers without data sanitization.
impact: Unintentional transmission of decrypted memory tokens, passwords, and private data in crash dumps.

title: Cloud Clipboard & Cross-Device History Sync
description: System copy-paste buffer continuously synchronized with Microsoft cloud infrastructure.
impact: High risk of credential, OTP, and confidential token exposure across external cloud sync nodes.

title: User Timeline & Activity History Telemetry
description: Compiles exhaustive logs of launched applications, opened files, and browsed web paths into cloud databases.
impact: Permanent chronological digital footprint stored locally and in account telemetry.

title: Geolocation Services & Sensor Coordinates
description: Hardware positioning sensors relay physical latitude and longitude coordinates to background subsystems.
impact: Continuous physical location harvesting and historical geodata tracking.

title: Universal App Diagnostic Data Interception
description: Permits sandboxed store applications to query telemetry logs and status indicators from other active processes.
impact: Cross-process surveillance and unauthorized execution profiling.

title: Recent Documents & Jump Lists Residual Artifacts
description: Windows maintains unencrypted records and shortcuts of recently opened confidential documents and folders.
impact: Local forensic recovery of confidential user workflow artifacts.

title: Cloud Content Delivery & Silent App Deployment
description: Automated background download of sponsored applications, Start suggestions, and lock screen promotions.
impact: Silent software payload installations and unapproved disk space consumption.
